message: App-wide feature/progress coordination moved to the central feature directory in gef-expo so the coordination tree mirrors the actual app feature tree.
rollcall_instruction: Update Clickabl/gef-expo/main/FEATURES/<feature>/status.json and FEATURES/manifest.json instead of rebuilding a second progress ledger in gef-lexicon.
note: This redirect does not move lesson/Lexicon/Lexi linguistic authority into Expo. Expo owns the app feature map; gef-lexicon remains canonical for its domain truth.
